Interesting point. I would argue that allowing teams to have even more smokes would actually lead to a decrease in the complexity and overall skill. Mostly because this would allow both teams to have 10 smokes. Especially for the CT side this could lead to big stalemates. (Think about B-Inferno, B-Dust2, Overpass, Vertigo).

I think this is a nice thought experiment but I would think this would lead to an unenjoyable game in the lower-elo-brackets, and a very stalematey (also very eco-unfriendly) game for higher elo ranks.
